title: Projection-time social cards (og:image) for items without an image (M)
description:
Generic Papyrus capability: at projection time, draw a social card for each page that has no image of its own, write it next to the page, and use it as og:image / twitter:image.

Asked for by Shipped (shipped.anth.us); also useful to every syndicating site (ryanalynporter.com cards read og:image, and latest.json `image`).

## Behaviour
- A site supplies a card template in projection.json (`seo.socialCards`): size (default 1200x630), background, wordmark image, font files, colours, and which fields to draw: title, section label, a status word from front matter, site name.
- At projection time, for each entry with no `image` and no `seo.image`, render a PNG and write it at a stable path next to the page (e.g. `/_cards/<slug>.png`), content-hashed so it is regenerated only when the drawn fields change.
- Set og:image, twitter:image and alt text ("<title> — <site name>") to it; the site's `seo.defaultImage` remains the fallback when cards are off.
- An item with its own image is never overridden. Story figures drawn from map data may supply the image instead (later, via PPY-fb4dfa).
- Text fits: long titles wrap and shrink within bounds, then truncate with an ellipsis; never overflow.
- Accessibility: no meaning carried by colour alone; adequate contrast checked against the template colours.
- Off unless configured. Deterministic output (same inputs give the same bytes), so projections stay idempotent and the #565 deletion guard sees no churn.

## Acceptance
- Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) and unit tests: card generated for an image-less item, not generated when the item has an image, regenerated only on a field change, long-title fitting, alt text, off by default.
- Shipped configures it and its item pages carry absolute og:image URLs (separate Shipped story).
- Docs: docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md (seo section).
